text:
Maya (PR): quick pulse — i uploaded the FINAL press pack to GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/press/pack_v5. need stat verification + a one-line blurb for the press release by EOD PT. @Sally (Data) can you confirm the token latency and cost numbers?
Sofia (PressOps): grabbing it now. noticed the throughput table has a different 'tokens/sec' for the long-context run vs the benchmark doc. flagging so we don't send conflicting figures.
Sally (Data): running the validation pipeline (nightly-run v2) — initial pass: median token latency on c7=7.4ms (n=1000). doc shows 6.1ms which is a micro-benchmark outlier. will produce median + p95 table.
Lucas (Product): which workload did the 6.1ms come from? was that the AK-3 short-context test? our public claim should call out workload explicitly.
Sally (Data): right — 6.1ms = single-run AK-3 @ seq=256, no batching. for the press pack i recommend: median 7.4ms, p95 12.9ms (c7, mixed gen). i'll attach the csv.
Jamal (Marketing): we also have "cost savings" blurb in the draft: "Redwood reduces inference costs by up to 3x for long-context generation" — can we validate the 3x claim vs the baseline? need conservative phrasing for press.
Sally (Data): 3x is accurate vs baseline model older-gen when using our KV cache + batching for long-contexts (>8k). for short-context or different hw it's closer to 1.5-2x. i'll put forward two blurbs: conservative and optimistic.
Maya (PR): perfect. conservative + optimistic options in the pack. also update analyst Q&A footnote on methodology (how we measure tokens/sec). @PressBot can you confirm publish window metadata? want to include timing in the media notes.
PressBot: Automated: press_pack_v5 uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood.ai/press/pack_v5.zip | publish_window: MORNING-US | contact: maya@redwood.ai | reference: stat-methods-v2.pdf
Sofia (PressOps): webinar follow-up ops question — routing rule proposal: attendees with >3 demo requests -> AE queue; others -> SDR. tag all with "webinar-2026-03" and add a "asked-pricing" boolean if they asked about pricing during Q&A.
Jamal (Marketing): +1. need example SQL to wire into hubspot import (so eng can automate). @Lucas can you paste a simple routing snippet?
Lucas (Product): sure — quick export example:
```
SELECT email, demos_requested, CASE WHEN demos_requested > 3 THEN 'AE' ELSE 'SDR' END as route
FROM webinar_attendees
WHERE event_id = 'webinar-2026-03';
```
Then push result to HubSpot list "webinar-2026-03-routing".
Sally (Data): i'll attach verified numbers to press_pack_v5 by 18:00 PT and include the methodology appendix. also exporting the CSV for the media team.
Maya (PR): awesome — last ask: if any analyst presses on methodology, point them to appendix file "stat-methods-v2.pdf" in the pack and offer a short follow-up call. i'll draft the short Q&A lines. :rocket:
Sofia (PressOps): will set up auto-tags in HubSpot and add the routing doc to the pack.
Jamal (Marketing): i'll update the release blurb to use the conservative line and keep the optimistic as an optional talking point for interviews.
Maya (PR): thanks team — feel free to ping if numbers change. we'll hold on sending to media until the verified table is in. :+1:
